name: Haruyoshi Fuuka
source:
Protagonist in [url=/c131378]Ichige Hokuto[/url]'s story, Fuuka and Hokuto are childhood friends who live next to each other. She works at a major trading company.
A frequent customer of Fill Flower. She is bright, active, and behaves adorably.
At work, she is considered as the ace among her peers, but she has been holding a long-standing unrequited love for Hokuto and is worried about their relationship.
